query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM background_tasks WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND (status = 'running' OR notified = 0)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wake_intents w LEFT JOIN agent_runs r ON r.id = w.run_id WHERE w.conversation_id = $1 AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled'))) AS "pending!: bool"
